purpose: State the final outcome after developments or uncertainty.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
I hesitated, but in the end I bought the blue one.
I called many times, but ultimately could not get in touch.
We took a detour and ended up being late.
restrictions: Often implies that alternatives or efforts did not change the ending.
mistake: Use ついに for reaching a long-awaited milestone; 結局 emphasizes the outcome.
